charts.title: TOI-5126 b: orbits around TOI-5126
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5126's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5126 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Fairnington et al. 2024 (2024MNRAS.527.8768F), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname FAIRNINGTON_ET_AL_2024): P 5.4588385 d

charts.title: TOI-5126 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-5126 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (46, 48, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 27064468, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 15-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 15-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
